description: Reduce the service coefficient after the equal-third experiment showed that service contributed more than half of the realized positive reward while only slightly improving waiting-time KPIs.

common.reward_normalization: Keep the proven throughput:Jain ratio at 37.5:62.5 inside the non-service portion. Only the service share changes. Delta rewards, standalone penalties and Lagrangian multipliers remain disabled.

cases.label: Service 5%, preserve throughput:Jain = 37.5:62.5
cases.hypothesis: Can a very small service term preserve the two-slot delay improvement without reducing goodput or Jain fairness?

cases.label: Service 10%, preserve throughput:Jain = 37.5:62.5
cases.hypothesis: Does a moderate service term create a clearer waiting-time benefit while remaining a secondary reward component?

cases.label: Service 15%, preserve throughput:Jain = 37.5:62.5
cases.hypothesis: How far can service be increased before it starts to dominate the reward and reduce throughput or fairness?
